headline: Approved tree removal at 208 Hart Street, issued an Order of Conditions for the Lynch Park eelgrass project, and continued other matters.
summary: The Commission reviewed certificates of compliance, tree removal requests, and notices of intent for several properties. It continued the Common Lane certificate and the 269 Dodge Street hearing to March 18, 2026, approved tree removal at 208 Hart Street with conditions, closed the hearing and issued an Order of Conditions for the Offshore Lynch Park eelgrass project, and approved a grant support letter and expenditure for mileage.
decisions: Continued the Certificate of Compliance for 110-228 Common Lane, DEP File #5-1405, to March 18, 2026, 5-0.
Approved the tree removal request at 208 Hart Street with conditions, 5-0.
Closed the hearing for Offshore Lynch Park, DEP File #5-1462, 5-0.
Continued the hearing for 269 Dodge Street, DEP File #5-1461, to March 18, 2026, 5-0.
Agreed to table the Enforcement Order for 10 Tall Tree Drive until information is received from MassDEP.
Approved the Commission's support letter for the Lynch Park grant application, 5-0.
Approved the Conservation Field Inspector January mileage in the amount of $9.65, 5-0.
Issued an Order of Conditions for Offshore Lynch Park, DEP File #5-1462, with special conditions, 5-0.
Approved the meeting minutes of February 3, 2026, as amended, 5-0.
